findings.title: EMR security configuration without in-transit encryption
findings.description: EMR clusters should encrypt data in transit between nodes. The security configuration JSON must set EnableInTransitEncryption to true. Absent or unparseable configuration is treated as undecidable.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.
